events.title: Alpha Fall LIVE
events.description_text:
Alpha sessions are a connection and conversation spanning the course of 12 weeks that explore the big questions of life, faith, and meaning in a judgement free environment: What is my purpose? What happens when I die? Why is there suffering?


Session includes food (Wednesdays), a 20-minute video on the Christian faith, and a small-group discussion. Must be 18+ years to participate. Full Alpha description here: https://alphausa.org/about.

events.title: Discipleship Courses
events.description_text:
Our Wednesday Night Discipleship Courses provide a place for you to learn, connect, and grow at every stage of your walk with God. Learn from practical, Bible-centered classes to build your foundation, explore your faith more deeply, and grow in wisdom for your everyday life. Go deeper! Grow stronger! Take your next step!


—
COURSE OFFERINGS - Courses run simultaneously on Wednesdays from 7-9 PM.
Please select only one.


• APOLOGETICS FOR EVERYONE - Why believe in God? Can the Bible be trusted? What do we do with questions about suffering? This course explores some of the biggest questions about Christianity and helps you build confidence in what you believe and why.


• EVANGELISM MASTER CLASS - Want to share your faith but not sure where to start? This course will help you grow in confidence and learn how to have natural, authentic gospel conversations through biblical teaching, real-life stories, and practical exercises.


• FINANCIAL PEACE UNIVERSITY - Take control of your money and achieve financial peace with Financial Peace University (FPU). This nine-lesson course based on biblical principles provides a step-by-step plan to get out of debt, save for the future, and build wealth while offering a supportive community for accountability and lasting change.

Registration not required


KLCC Town Hall is a special gathering for adults ages 65 and older. This is an opportunity to share your thoughts, experiences, and needs as we listen and explore how KLCC can better serve you and help you feel seen, valued, and connected.

events.title: Communion Sunday
events.description_text: Communion is a significant act of worship and an essential part of the Christian journey. It offers a moment for personal reflection on Christ’s sacrifice, its meaning in our lives, and an opportunity to examine our relationship with Him. It's also a time to anticipate His return. As we share in this sacred celebration, invite the Holy Spirit to search your heart and guide your life.

events.title: Baptism
events.description_text:
If you have made the decision to follow Jesus Christ, we encourage you to be baptized!


- Baptism Class – Prior to the ceremony a virtual class will be held Wednesday, November 4, 7 PM (subject to change). This preparation class goes into further detail about what baptism is and its role in your Christian walk.
- Baptism Ceremony – Sunday, November 8 during the 10 AM service at the Cathedral. 
- Please note, children must be at least in 5th grade to participate in baptism.


*Deadline to register is November 4.


Email Pastor Brandon to find out more, mailto:bkellum@klcc.us.
